summary: Formalize full PTX ISA 9.4 and support reusable TorchLean-to-kernel verification.
Explain the computing model and verification contracts through source-linked documentation and reproducible examples.
remaining: Restricted whole-word/bytewise memory models, scalar execution/rules and shared-allocation kernel proofs are implemented. Full PTX coverage, settled torn-observation semantics, general dependent concurrency, TorchLean interfaces, numerical/backward infrastructure and application examples remain unimplemented.
